text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival.
The Umamusume are interacting all over campus
with the many fans who have gathered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond was also surrounded by female fans,
happily chatting away.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I really, truly love
the way Diamond-san runs!!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan A
text_block_list.text: The way she charged straight ahead without looking back was so beautiful and cool...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I'm so happy!!
You've been cheering for me all this time!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We just had to see Diamond-san in person,
so this little one and I came to watch at the track for the first time!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
After watching the Kikuka Sho in person, I totally fell for Diamond-san too!!
The Winning Live was super cute as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My, your first time at a racetrack?!
Thank you so much for coming for my sake!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan A
text_block_list.text: I thought it would be terribly presumptuous of me, but... being able to talk with you directly... I'm so, so thrilled...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, being invited like this
makes me feel like I'm walking on air♪

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Um, Diamond-san, are you participating
in any of the performances today as well?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'm participating in 'Giant Memory Match: Ruthless Battle'!
We lay out huge cards on the field and play a game of Memory♪"

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan B
text_block_list.text: ...What does 'battles without honor' mean...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's a competition where you run around collecting cards.
There's no set order to flip them, so it's first come, first served."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Also, if you draw a "Challenge Card,"
you can challenge another player to a duel,
and if you win, you get to steal their card♪

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan B
text_block_list.text: T-That's intense...

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still, Diamond-san can definitely win!
I'll be there cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu! If you're cheering for me,
Dia will give it her absolute best♪

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fans
text_block_list.text: S-So... cute~~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! Secretly watching me like that
is mean, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I didn't want to put a damper on things, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told them that both she and the fans seemed to be having fun, so I decided not to intrude.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I got a bit carried away...
How embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Attention, please.
Participants for the "Battles Without Honor: Grand Memory Match"
please gather in the waiting area.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, sounds like I've been called.
Here I go!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text: “—Now, the ultimate test of wit and endurance, the 'Ruthless Mega Memory Game'! Our six players make their grand entrance!”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Intuition, hunches, and hot-blooded passion!
Victory is totally miiiiiiine!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
River crabs, horsehair crabs, snow crabs!!
Aw yeah, it's a crab festival, baby!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... Quite an interesting lineup we've got here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa... count me out of your little school play, alright?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, right... You match the identical pictures...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ? Cafe-san, who are you talking to...?

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All six competitors are in their starting positions!
Let the ruthless Mega Memory Match begin!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Now, this event is a memory matching game
where you flip cards placed on the course
and earn points by matching pairs!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOOOO!!
The patterns didn't maaaatch!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Since all players flip cards simultaneously,
it demands far more memory skill than standard Concentration!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...All right! Got one pair set♪

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond is steadily
and surely racking up points!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...What's this!? Manhattan Cafe is matching
pictures one after another and is now in first place in points!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...The matching picture is... on the far right over there...
Yes, thank goodness... Thank you..."

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Not a single false move so far!
Could double-checking every answer before flipping the card be the secret to this flawless run?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Under 5 minutes remaining!
...Wait, what's this? Nakayama Festa makes a move!
Is she going to use that item she drew earlier?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, milady.
I'll be playing my trump card now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: !! A challenge letter...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Nakayama Festa!
She's thrust a challenge letter right at Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Both sides consult and agree upon a point value for the Challenge Card,
and the winner takes those points from the loser!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hold on!! I have a challenge letter too!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And now, Sirius Symboli joins the fray!!
This challenge match has turned into a three-way battle!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: So? How many points are you betting?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...How about 500 points?
With that much, I will be able to catch up to Cafe-san.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, keeping your cool, huh?
It would've been a lot more fun
if you'd gone all in on a whim.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Alright, one round to decide it all. Here I come—

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Rock, paper, scissors, go!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yay!! I won!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, didn't fall for the trick, huh?
Fine then, take it!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond earns 1000 points!
She's tied with 1st place Manhattan Cafeーー!!
—Howeverッ!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …………I won.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaagh, dammiiiiit!!
My "steal it all from the top" plan is...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe wins the challenge match against Gold Ship!!
She has taken all of Gold Ship's points!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"And that's time!!
The winner of 'Ruthless Giant Concentration' is...
Manhattan Cafe!"

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Diamond-san, that was so close!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still, I got to see so many different sides
of Diamond-san, so it was fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, I'm so glad you enjoyed it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Being able to interact directly with her fans made the Fan Appreciation Festival a fun one for Satono Diamond as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All-in, with all my points!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Going all-in, huh? How thrilling!
I'm in!!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I got no complaints either!
Let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Rock, paper, scissors, go!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yay!! I won!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...To think you'd beat me in a battle of wits...
Good grief, what an incredible young lady."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Take all of my points.

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond takes the points from Nakayama Festa
and Sirius Symboli!!
She overtakes Manhattan Cafe to claim 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-hah-hah-hah!!
I've been waiting for this exact moment! The ULTIMATE third-party triumph!
I challenge Satono to a duelーー!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's an all-out showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Rock, paper, scissors...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, looks like my win♪

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Satono Diamond has completely
seen through Gold Ship's strategy!!
She sweeps the tricky Gold Ship aside in one fell swoop--!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"And that's time!!
The winner of 'Ruthless Giant Concentration' is...
Satono Diamond!"

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Diamond-san,
congratulations on your victory!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan A
text_block_list.text: To think Diamond-san had such a bold side to her...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Because everyone
was watching, I gave it my absolute all!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're way... way too cool~~!!
Please let me keep cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Same here!
We're counting on your cheers♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Being able to interact directly with her fans made the Fan Appreciation Festival a fun one for Satono Diamond as well.
